errors.meaning: Credentials are valid but not allowed this action or item.
The root or item does not exist.
The target exists and overwrite is fail, or a folder still has contents.
A destructive action was called without the destructive option.
The provider asked to slow down; retry_after_ms when known.
Endpoint, region, addressing or root is wrong or insecure without the development override.
Connection, DNS, TLS or timeout failure before a provider answer.
The caller cancelled or the deadline passed.
The provider lacks the capability; hosts check capabilities first.
Any other provider failure; provider_code and request_id kept for support.
